summary: Iteration 3 regression pass. All cosmetic refactors (nested-ternary -> if/else / IIFE / lookup-map / helper functions in VededLogo, GenerationStudio, Pricing, Dashboard, BookStreamDetail; Python type hints in server.py + routes_bookstream.py) are behavior-neutral. Backend pytest 25/25 pass. Frontend E2E clean: Landing renders with VededLogo, signup -> /app dashboard works, Pricing planCta produces correct labels (free/current plan -> 'Current plan' since fresh user owns free tier; veded_standard -> Sparkles+'Upgrade'; disabled state respected). Stripe checkout redirect on veded_standard -> https://checkout.stripe.com/... verified. GenerationStudio ETA lookup map yields ~28s (video), ~8s (audio), ~4.2s (images) verified in DOM. Movies studio shows paywall for free-tier user so ~4m ETA is intentionally hidden (paywall gate — same behavior as iteration 2). BookStreamDetail cinematic hero for fresh user shows 'Start 1-video free trial' (bs-trial testid present). Post-trial state transition covered by backend tests (test_bookstream_trial_first_ok / _second_blocked pass). Nano Banana real generation still returns generator_used='gemini-nano-banana' with data:image/... base64 (~968KB). Zero React key/hook warnings observed. No new regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: planCta() ordering places `owned` before `loading`; since the Buy button is disabled when owned, this is correct — but if owned+loading ever combined the loading state would be hidden. Not a bug today.

MoviesStudio + WebSeriesStudio hide GenerationStudio (and thus its ~4m/~28s ETA) behind veded_team-only paywall. Testing spec (g) mentioned '~4m' visibility; note it only renders once a user has veded_team tier — matches iteration 2 behavior.

BookStreamDetail canPlay uses `user?.trial_used` as a truthy grant. This means after a used trial (trial_used=true) the user still sees 'Play' rather than 'Subscribe to Watch'. The review spec (f) implies the latter — but this is unchanged from iteration 2 and not a new regression from iteration 3 refactor.

Prior iteration_1/2 comments still apply (JWT_SECRET dev fallback, audio-char max() over-charge, hardcoded sk_test_emergent fallback, CORS allow_origins='*' with credentials, trial device_fingerprint edge case).
test_credentials: Fresh signup users per run (review<ts>@veded.io / password123).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 confirms iteration 2 behavior. In browser E2E, /api/bookstream/trial returns 403 for repeated signups from the same browser because getDeviceFingerprint() is stable per browser — expected abuse-prevention. To test post-trial 'Play Free Preview' via UI, use a fresh browser context per signup or set a unique device_fingerprint. Backend tests already cover the branch. Movies + WebSeries GenerationStudio ETAs are gated by veded_team tier.
